historical_context: TARGETED_THREAT_AUDIT recorded niti_requires_distinct_constitutive_contact_coupling = true with evidence_status = established, while Astra determined evidence was insufficient.

historical_context: Early MP1 framing treated actively varied positive confinement pressure P3 as a potentially novel mechanics principle distinguishing MP1 from passive cables.
difference: Active pressure treated as novel mechanics principle vs experimental control boundary condition.
why_it_matters: Demoted P3 from mechanics novelty to experimental boundary condition p(t). Normal traction equations naturally accept time-varying pressure without new constitutive physics.
